caption:
Nvidia stock fell 14% on Friday to $125.53, about $491 billion of market value in one session, after Reuters reported that SEC enforcement staff are examining potential accounting issues. Nvidia hadn't commented; the SEC declined to comment.
It came three days after record quarterly sales of $115.8 billion. Its quarterly filing (10-Q) is due December 4.
